name: dsh-dialog-watcher
description:
让 DSH 知道「你跑的东西卡在一个 Windows 弹窗上了」。常驻检测桌面阻塞弹窗（错误框 / SmartScreen / 安装向导 / 凭据请求 / 系统询问卡片），判定它由哪个会话的命令引起，把一条事件提醒注入该会话；模型据此判断，并可用 dialog_action 代点按钮——不抢前台、不激活窗口。

A Windows blocking-dialog watcher for DSH: resident detection of error boxes, SmartScreen prompts, installers, credential requests and system consent cards; attributes each dialog to the session whose command raised it and injects a structured notice; the model can then decide and click buttons via dialog_action without stealing focus or activating the window.
